mechanism.claim: A high-volatility break of a completed three-day price channel that subsequently pulls back inside the old range without losing its directional half, then reclaims the frozen boundary, represents tested price discovery and should continue over 72 hours.
mechanism.why_distinct: HVDCR is a causal multi-step episode with a frozen old boundary, defended pullback, and later reclaim. It is not the rejected raw Donchian crossing plus ATR exit, a single-bar range breakout, or a terminal candidate/control modification.
mechanism.prior_art_boundary: the repository forbids retrying raw 5m Donchian+ATR grids but explicitly permits a materially different trend-pullback recovery or slower execution horizon

clock.decision: every completed 5m bar; entry is the next exact 5m open
clock.channel: prior 864 completed 5m bars, shifted one bar; current bar excluded
clock.breakout: false-to-true close above prior high or below prior low while range_vol is at or above frozen 2023H1 q60; freeze high, low, midpoint, direction, and breakout time
clock.defended_pullback: long: close<=frozen high and close>=frozen midpoint; short: close>=frozen low and close<=frozen midpoint
clock.reclaim_window: within 24 elapsed hours after the first defended pullback
clock.reclaim: long close>frozen high; short close<frozen low
clock.episode_rules: one pending episode globally; expiry or a close through the opposite frozen boundary cancels; no replacement while pending
clock.calibration: 2023H1 source-only range_vol q60; no forward return or PnL
clock.reservation: global half-open after accepted reclaim; exit first on equal open

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no channel, timing, side, hold, or gate repair
